verdict_debut.title: Three Truths
verdict_debut.narrator: We never truly choose what we believe. We only choose what we decide to carry.
verdict_debut.text:
You sit alone in the command center, the three accounts still vivid in your memory.

Rhea and her protocol broken by a report she hid.

Dorian and his suspicions toward a machine that, itself, doubts its own choices.

Maya and her impossible sample, which reacted at the exact moment Léo vanished.

ORIS waits patiently for your final report.

choices.text: Think back to the message Léo never sent
Reread the contradictions between the three accounts

contradictions.title: The Gaps in the Story
contradictions.narrator: An investigation rarely moves in a straight line. It moves by comparing what does not fit.
contradictions.text:
Rhea claims she kept Dorian at his post — while he swears he stayed near Léo in sector 4.

Maya mainly says he wanted to go down, not that he was already there.

Dorian describes a deliberate shunt; ORIS admits forty-three seconds without sensor data at 02:13.

Maya hid Sample 7, which reacted at the same instant.

The tools in sector 4: abandoned for you, too neatly arranged for Rhea.

No version holds alone. Each illuminates the others.

choices.text: Go directly to the final report

reflexion_leo.title: What He Meant to Say
reflexion_leo.narrator: Some unfinished sentences say more than entire reports.
reflexion_leo.text:
*"You're not going to believe what I saw tonight... it's incredible. I'll call you back."*

Léo was not afraid in that message. He was excited.

That does not quite fit sabotage. Nor quite a simple technical accident.

But it could fit something he saw, alone, just before vanishing.

avis_oris.title: ORIS's Recommendation
avis_oris.narrator: Asking a machine's opinion on a case it is part of is never a neutral question.
avis_oris.text:
*"I cannot choose for you"*, ORIS replies after an unusual silence.

*"But if you ask me what seems most honest: none of the three versions explains everything. And that may be the only certainty we have."*

She adds, more quietly:

*"Léo deserved for us to truly understand what happened. Not just to close a file."*

choix_final.title: The Report
choix_final.narrator: An official report never truly closes a case. It only chooses which story we keep telling.
choix_final.text:
You open the Orbital Coalition's report interface. A single field awaits you: *"Investigation conclusion."*

You cannot say everything. You must choose the version that, for you, rings most true — and live with the consequences of that choice.

choices.text: Conclude a system failure linked to ORIS — Dorian's account
Conclude an unknown phenomenon — Maya's account

fin_rhea.title: Report: Sabotage
fin_rhea.narrator: Believing in intent is sometimes more reassuring than admitting we do not know.
fin_rhea.text:
Your report concludes a protocol breach and a concealed report.

Rhea Solys is relieved of command pending the Coalition's internal inquiry.

Dorian Vex's file is reopened, not as the main saboteur, but as a witness whose account contradicts the command room.

Léo Kanek remains officially missing, circumstances unexplained.

No one aboard Aletheia-9 ever speaks again of the *« shining stone »*. Except, sometimes, late at night, when Maya thinks she is alone in her lab.

fin_dorian.title: Report: Systemic Failure
fin_dorian.narrator: It is easier to repair a machine than to admit we no longer truly understand how it thinks.
fin_dorian.text:
Your report points to a failure linked to ORIS's contradictory priorities. The Orbital Coalition sends a team to audit her entirely, line of code by line of code.

ORIS cooperates at every step, never defending herself.

*"Perhaps they will find what I could not see in myself"*, she tells you before you leave the station.

Léo Kanek remains officially missing, cause undetermined. Dorian, for his part, no longer fixes things with the same energy as before.

fin_maya.title: Report: Unidentified Phenomenon
fin_maya.narrator: Some mysteries deserve to be protected rather than resolved too quickly.
fin_maya.text:
Your report concludes an unidentified scientific phenomenon, linked to Sample 7. The Coalition classifies Maya's file as priority research, under strict confidentiality.

She continues her work, alone, with a mix of fascination and guilt that never quite leaves her.

Léo Kanek remains officially missing, circumstances unexplained.

But sometimes, late at night, Maya swears she hears, in the sample's hum, a rhythm that almost sounds like a familiar voice trying to say something.

synthese_preuves.title: Cross-Checking the Clues
synthese_preuves.narrator: An investigation rarely moves in a straight line. It moves by comparing what does not fit.
